summary: Backend-only security batch verification (iteration 11) for Trexio: strict CSP with per-request nonce, login hardening/backdoor removal, register field validation, hardcoded credential removal, server-side checkout pricing, Midtrans webhook signature enforcement, generic error responses, and auth rate limiting. Created /app/backend/tests/test_security_batch11.py — 16/16 pytest tests PASSED (JUnit: /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration11.xml). CSP verified: script-src has 'self' + 'nonce-...' + 'strict-dynamic', no 'unsafe-inline'/'unsafe-eval' anywhere in the header; object-src 'none', frame-ancestors 'self', base-uri 'self' present; nonce differs between two consecutive GET /api/trips requests. Extra headers verified: X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Permissions-Policy, COOP=same-origin, HSTS. Login: traveler@trexio.id/traveler123 => 200 + token; superadmin@trexio.id with admin123 and trexio123 => 401; trexioadventure@gmail.com/admin123 => 401; admin@trexio.id/'Trexio!Admin#2026Secure' => 200 requires_2fa=true. Register: short password => 400 'Kata sandi minimal 8 karakter.', invalid email => 400 'Format email tidak valid.', valid registration => success (no password_hash leaked), duplicate => 400 'Email sudah terdaftar...'. Booking: no Authorization => 401; client-supplied total_amount=5 ignored, server returned 1700000 (850000x2); trip_id 'tidak_ada' => 404 generic Indonesian message with no stack trace/'/app/' path leak. Midtrans notification without signature_key => 503 (rejected, not processed; MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY unset). Rate limit (run last): repeated failed logins returned 401 then 429 as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: script-src includes blanket 'https:' alongside 'strict-dynamic'; in CSP3-capable browsers 'strict-dynamic' makes host allowlists ignored, so this is only a legacy-browser fallback — acceptable but worth noting.
style-src still keeps 'unsafe-inline' (documented as required by React/Tailwind inline styles); acceptable for now but a nonce/hash-based style-src would fully close XSS-via-CSS vectors.

admin@trexio.id/admin123 was not exercised over HTTP (auth attempt budget/IP lock), but grep confirms no hardcoded 'admin123'/'trexio123'/'SuperAdmin2026!' master passwords remain in server.js and the identical superadmin@trexio.id path returned 401 — no backdoor.
server.js is a single very large monolith (>13k lines); recommend splitting into route/middleware modules for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: One throwaway user freshuser_<random>@test.com (password ValidPass123) created by the register test; one booking for trip_01 (traveler account) created by the checkout pricing test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: the H-1 rate-limit test was executed at the end of this iteration, so this container's IP may be locked out of /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register (429) for up to 15 minutes. Wait before re-running auth tests. authLimiter = max 15 FAILED auth attempts/15min/IP, shared by login+register, successful requests skipped. Keep failed auth attempts minimal and always place the rate-limit test last (file/class name TestZZRateLimit ensures ordering). Midtrans webhook cannot be tested end-to-end (MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY unset => 503); gross_amount fraud check sits behind signature verification and was reviewed in code only.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found in this batch; all 8 requested verification areas behave as specified.
